info.title: MyID Core API 12.18.0
info.description:
The MyID Core API service is a REST based API allowing access to the MyID environment.

All calls to the service must be made with a JWT issued from MyIDAuth service. This token will identify the operator.

The content available will be restricted by the operator's permissions. Not all end points in this document will be available to all operators.

The models used in this API are largely data driven and managed by MyID Project Designer. Some fields may have additional security applied to them so may not be available to all operators. The endpoints available may also be further restricted based on the edition and configuration of your MyID installation.

Operators can retrieve only those objects within their scope. If you cannot retrieve a specific record, it may be that you do not have permission to retrieve it.

All end points may contain links to other actions that are related to the current object. These actions vary by system configuration and operator permissions, and so only a generic example is included in this API document.

  • href - The href required for performing an HTTP GET on the result item

get.description:
Return an unordered list of Credential Profiles that the Person can receive.
Additional filtering can be applied by using the canRequest and canReceive parameters.
The values that are returned for each search result are as follows:
  • id - The ID of the result item
  • name - The name of the result item
  • maxRequestExpiryDate - Indicates the maximum date that a request for the target user with the given credential profile. An empty string is returned if the credential profile is set to ignore handling of maximum request expiry dates or if such a date is not set on the target user.
  • href - The href required for performing an HTTP GET on the result item

If a large number of results are to be returned, they may be returned in pages. If this is the case, each page will indicate if there are more pages of results available using an entry in the 'links' property. This link will provide the URL to retrieve the next page of results.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of cancellation reasons.
get.description:
Retrieve a list of all the valid reasons to perform an action on the device such as canceling the device
Each Status Mapping defines what happens to the device and the credentials on the device.
The available Status Mappings vary by operation id. For a restricted list, use the operationId parameter.
The values that are returned for the Status Mappings are as follows:
  • id - The ID of the Status Mapping
  • status - The status of the Status Mapping
  • pkiAction - The action that is taken on the certificates stored on a device. Possible values are as follows:
    • -1: Do not do anything with the certificate
    • 0: Revoke certificate (no reason given)
    • 1 through 5: Revoke certificate (reason given)
    • 6: Suspend certificate
  • archivePkiAction - The action that is taken on the archived certificates stored on a device. Possible values extend on pkiAction and are as follows:
    • -2: No action carried out on certificate, certificiate is recovered to a replacement device.
  • cardAction - The action that is taken on the device. Possible values are as follows:
    • Perm: Cancel card.
    • Temp: Disable card.
    • None: No action carried out.
  • enableNotify - Indicates whether a user is notified when the Status Mapping is carried out. Possible values are as follows:
    • 0: Inhibit 'Card Canceled' email.
    • 1: Normal notification behavior will occur.
  • furtherAction - Describes additional actions to be carried out on the device.

12.5 First introduced. 1.0

get.summary: Retrieve details of the root group of a directory and its child groups.
get.description:
Typically used for rendering a tree representation of a directory structure.
This endpoint is restricted by scope when the operator exists within the directory that is specified by the 'id' parameter. The following scope based rules are enforced:
  • If the operator's scope is self or department, only the operator's own organizational unit is returned.
  • If the operator's scope is division, then the operator's organizational unit and any children organizational units are returned.

If scope restrictions are applied, the operator's admin groups will continue to be returned.
Only the first level of children will be returned along with the root organizational unit. To descend into lower levels of children, browse the directory with the ID of one of the children organizational units of root.

post.summary: Create a mobile Request for the Person.
post.description:
Create a Request for a mobile credential issuance for a Person.
  • The field target.id is ignored.
  • credProfile.id must match the id of the Credential Profile that is to be issued to the Person.
  • jobId is provided to allow the Request to be cross-referenced with Jobs using other processes (such as Validate Request in MyID Desktop).
  • jobLabel can be provided to allow for groupings of Requests.
  • device is used to force the Request to only be able to be collected to the specified Device.

Setting an expiry date.
  • expiryDate can used to specify the expiry date for the request if SET CARD EXPIRY DATE AT REQUEST is YES, and can either be a date only, or a full date time
  • If only a date is provided, then EXPIRE CARDS AT END OF DAY is applied to determine the time of the expiry
  • If a full date time is provided then the specified time is honoured
  • The Request is created with the earliest of the target user max request expiry date (if they have one) and the requested expiry date
  • If no expiryDate is provided, then the Request is created with the target user max request expiry date (if they have one)
  • If the selected credential profile does not adhere to the target user max request expiry date, then the specified expiryDate is honoured
  • If SET CARD EXPIRY DATE AT REQUEST is NO, then any expiryDate provided is ignored

12.7 First introduced. 1.0

post.summary: Request a card for a directory user
post.description:
Requesting a card for a directory user has the effect of importing the user into MyID.
The credprofile.id field in the body can be obtained from 'dirs/{directoryId}/people/{dirPersonId}/credprofiles'.
The response will be the newly created request.
The system should be set up so that when a directory user is imported as part of the request process, they possess a role that is suitable for the credential profile specified.
If the configuration flag CREATE GROUPS FROM OU is set to YES, and no valid group exists in MyID to hold the account, a suitable one will automatically be created for new users.
If the configuration flag CREATE GROUPS FROM OU is set to NO, and no valid group exists in MyID to hold the account, then new users will be placed in the root group.
The card request cannot be carried out if the operator does not have scope over the target user.

The exact fields available depend upon operator permissions and system configuration.
In addition to the mandatory fields defined in Project Designer, either a name.first, name.last, or both must be provided.
When setting maxRequestExpiryDate, if only a date is provided, then EXPIRE CARDS AT END OF DAY is used to determine whether the user max credential expiry should have a time of 00:00:00 or 23:59:00. If a date with a specific time is provided, that time is honoured, and EXPIRE CARDS AT END OF DAY is not used.
Facial biometrics will only be able to be enrolled if the configuration flag 'PREFACE CAPTURE' is set to YES. Attempts to enroll Facial biometrics while this value is set to NO will be ignored.

post.summary: Create a mobile Request for the Person.
post.description:
Create a Request for a mobile credential issuance for a Person.
  • The field target.id is ignored.
  • credProfile.id must match the id of the Credential Profile that is to be issued to the Person.
  • jobId is provided to allow the Request to be cross-referenced with Jobs using other processes (such as Validate Request in MyID Desktop).
  • jobLabel can be provided to allow for groupings of Requests.
  • device is used to force the Request to only be able to be collected to the specified Device.

Setting an expiry date.
  • expiryDate can used to specify the expiry date for the request if SET CARD EXPIRY DATE AT REQUEST is YES, and can either be a date only, or a full date time
  • If only a date is provided, then EXPIRE CARDS AT END OF DAY is applied to determine the time of the expiry
  • If a full date time is provided then the specified time is honoured
  • The Request is created with the earliest of the target user max request expiry date (if they have one) and the requested expiry date
  • If no expiryDate is provided, then the Request is created with the target user max request expiry date (if they have one)
  • If the selected credential profile does not adhere to the target user max request expiry date, then the specified expiryDate is honoured
  • If SET CARD EXPIRY DATE AT REQUEST is NO, then any expiryDate provided is ignored

get.summary: Retrieve a list of cancellation reasons.
get.description:
Retrieve a list of all the valid reasons to perform an action on the person such as disabling a person
Each Status Mapping defines what happens to the person
The available Status Mappings vary by operation id. For a restricted list, use the operationId parameter.
The values that are returned for the Status Mappings are as follows:
  • id - The ID of the Status Mapping
  • status - The status of the Status Mapping
  • pkiAction - The action that is taken on the certificates stored on a device. Possible values are as follows:
    • -1: Do not do anything with the certificate
    • 0: Revoke certificate (no reason given)
    • 1 through 5: Revoke certificate (reason given)
    • 6: Suspend certificate
  • archivePkiAction - The action that is taken on the archived certificates stored on a device. Possible values extend on pkiAction and are as follows:
    • -2: No action carried out on certificate, certificiate is recovered to a replacement device.
  • cardAction - The action that is taken on the device. Possible values are as follows:
    • Perm: Cancel card.
    • Temp: Disable card.
    • None: No action carried out.
  • enableNotify - Indicates whether a user is notified when the Status Mapping is carried out. Possible values are as follows:
    • 0: Inhibit 'Card Canceled' email.
    • 1: Normal notification behavior will occur.
  • furtherAction - Describes additional actions to be carried out on the device.

12.5 First introduced. 1.0

post.summary: Approve a Request
post.description:
Approve a Request that has the status "Awaiting Validation".
The status property passed to this endpoint will be ignored.
A successful approval will result in the Request status being set to "Awaiting Issue".
You can optionally provide some notes related to the approval using the unmappedReason property.
To change the credential profile, you must configure CHANGE CREDENTIAL PROFILE AT APPROVAL to be YES. Otherwise, any credential profile supplied will be ignored.
The approval will be audited.

    Setting or changing the expiry date.
    • expiryDate can used to specify the expiry date for the Request if SET CARD EXPIRY DATE AT REQUEST is YES, and can either be a date only, or a full date time
    • If only a date is provided then EXPIRE CARDS AT END OF DAY is applied to determine the time of the expiry
    • If a full date time is provided then the specified time is honoured
    • The Request is created with the earliest of the target user max request expiry date (if they have one) and the requested expiry date
    • If no expiryDate is provided, then the the Request is updated with target user max request expiry date (if they have one)
    • If the selected credential profile does not adhere to the target user max request expiry date, then the specified expiryDate is honoured
    • If SET CARD EXPIRY DATE AT REQUEST is NO, any expiryDate provided is ignored

get.summary: Return a list of Roles
get.description:
This endpoint returns a list of roles that are scoped to the passed in group and operation. To retrieve all the roles use the /roles/list endpoint.
Roles represent sets of permissions that can be assigned to a Person. The permissions for a Role are handled by the Edit Roles workflow.
A Role has a Scope associated with it. This indicates who the Role owner can use their Role against.
The valid values for scope are:
  • all - Everyone in the system
  • division - Everyone in the persons group and children of that group
  • department - Everyone in the persons group
  • self - only against the persons own account
  • none - the Role cannot be used against any person.

It is not possible to assign a Role where the scope is greater than the scope of the operator.
The values that are returned for each Role are as follows:
  • id - The ID of the Role
  • name - The name of the Role
  • defScope - The scope that the system assigns to new users based on the groups default Roles
  • maxScope - The maximum scope that the operator can assign to a user or themself
  • readOnly - Indicates whether the operator can modify or Role or not.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of cancellation reasons.
get.description:
Retrieve a list of all the valid reasons to perform an actions such as canceling a device or disabling a person.
Each Status Mapping defines what happens to the device and the credentials on the device.
The available Status Mappings vary by operation id. For a restricted list, use the operationId parameter.
The values that are returned for the Status Mappings are as follows:
  • id - The ID of the Status Mapping
  • status - The status of the Status Mapping
  • pkiAction - The action that is taken on the certificates stored on a device. Possible values are as follows:
    • -1: Do not do anything with the certificate
    • 0: Revoke certificate (no reason given)
    • 1 through 5: Revoke certificate (reason given)
    • 6: Suspend certificate
  • archivePkiAction - The action that is taken on the archived certificates stored on a device. Possible values extend on pkiAction and are as follows:
    • -2: No action carried out on certificate, certificiate is recovered to a replacement device.
  • cardAction - The action that is taken on the device. Possible values are as follows:
    • Perm: Cancel card.
    • Temp: Disable card.
    • None: No action carried out.
  • enableNotify - Indicates whether a user is notified when the Status Mapping is carried out. Possible values are as follows:
    • 0: Inhibit 'Card Canceled' email.
    • 1: Normal notification behavior will occur.
  • furtherAction - Describes additional actions to be carried out on the device.

12.2 First introduced. 1.0

parameters.description: The operation ID for the required list

Retrieve a list of the specified user's Admin Groups.
User Admin Groups will be returned only if the specified user is in scope.
User Admin Groups will be returned only if the configuration flag 'SCOPE USERADMINGROUPS' is set to YES.
If the specified user is in scope, all of their User Admin Groups will be returned, even if they are not in scope.
Each User Admin Group has a 'readOnly' property. If a User Admin Group is not in the operator's scope and cannot be modified, the 'readOnly' value will be 'true'.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of allowed expressions for fields from the DataDictionary table.
get.description:
Retrieve a list of allowed expressions for fields from the DataDictionary table.
The 'name' property of each result corresponds to the ValidationType of DataDictionary table entries.
This endpoint can be used to determine which expressions are allowed as an input for form fields retrieved from the GET api/forms endpoint.
Results with a null 'expr' property indicate that DataDictionary fields with that ValidationType do not require Validation by default.
An error accompanied with a code is provided to be displayed to the user should a Validation rule be broken.

12.2 First introduced. 1.0
